name: Alte Post
beschreibung: The Hotel Alte Post is situated in a central location in a Tyrolean village. The rooms are functionally furnished in an alpine style. The property features a restaurant serving regional cuisine as well as a wellness area. The surrounding area is ideal for hikers and winter sports enthusiasts. A special feature is the historic premises, which reflect the property's traditional character. Guests can look forward to quiet accommodation with practical amenities and a regional atmosphere.
